# Android key attestation test chains

Real attestation certificate chains, each with a JSON description of its parsed contents, copied unchanged from Google's [android/keyattestation](https://github.com/android/keyattestation) repository (`testdata/`, Apache License 2.0), on 17 November 2026. File names are `<device>_<sdk>_<security level>_<variant>`. `invalid_*` chains are Google's deliberately malformed samples.

They are test data only: none of them belongs to LONGYU.
